description: This file declares functions related to handling hex-encoded hash objects (like Git object IDs), including reading, converting, and parsing object IDs with support for different hash algorithms. It includes external dependencies on 'hash.h' and 'hex-ll.h'.

methods.name: get_oid_hex_algop
methods.description: Reads a hash in hexadecimal format and converts it into binary form, supporting different hash algorithms.

methods.name: hash_to_hex_algop_r
methods.description: Converts binary hash to hexadecimal string using specified hash algorithm; reentrant version.

methods.name: oid_to_hex_r
methods.description: Converts object ID to hex string; reentrant version.

methods.name: hash_to_hex_algop
methods.description: Converts binary hash to hex string using specified hash algorithm; static buffer version.

methods.name: oid_to_hex
methods.description: Converts object ID to hex string; static buffer version.

methods.name: parse_oid_hex_algop
methods.description: Parses a hex string into an object ID, supporting specific hash algorithms.

methods.name: get_oid_hex_any
methods.description: Determines the algorithm based on hex string length and parses into object ID.

methods.name: parse_oid_hex_any
methods.description: Determines the algorithm based on hex string length and parses into object ID.

methods.name: get_hash_hex
methods.description: Reads a hex-encoded hash into binary form using the default hash algorithm.

methods.name: get_oid_hex
methods.description: Reads a hex-encoded object ID into binary form using the default hash algorithm.

methods.name: parse_oid_hex
methods.description: Parses a hex string into an object ID using the default hash algorithm.

methods.name: hash_to_hex
methods.description: Converts binary hash to hex string using the default hash algorithm.
